title: Device overheating & thermal throttling dropping frame rate
symptoms: FPS drops significantly after 10-15 minutes of gameplay
Device gets hot to the touch
oyun 10 dakika sonra isiniyor ve fps dusuyor
Thermal throttling alerts in device logs
causes: Target frame rate is uncapped or unnecessarily set to 60/120 FPS on budget hardware
Expensive computational or physics calculations executing every frame in Update() loop
Heavy alpha overdraw and unoptimized full-screen transparent particles

solution.action: Cap target frame rate based on game genre (e.g., Application.targetFrameRate = 30 or 60).
Listen to device thermal status APIs and dynamically lower rendering resolution or shadow cascades when device enters severe thermal state.
Profile transparent UI panels and particle systems to eliminate overlapping alpha fillrate bottlenecks.

prevention: Conduct 30-minute continuous play sessions on mid/low-tier release builds while monitoring thermal profiling curves.
